about_the_game:
Hi everyone! Welcome to RaceOnLife, the first open-world racing MMO where freedom, skill, and pure luck intertwine in a high-stakes game of speed and strategy.

Start your journey with a gripping storyline full of secrets and unexpected twists. Conduct your own investigation, relying on your intuition and skills to uncover the island's secrets and reach the final race.

🌍 World: Snake Roads Island

A dynamic island divided between chaos and order. Bustling city streets, cozy suburban neighborhoods, quiet fishing villages, dangerous fighting arenas, colorful race tracks, and much more - the island breathes full life.

🧩 Journey: A story told through action

You arrive with nothing - no car, no name, no glory. The game world is full of mysterious characters; NPCs have their minds, each has their domain, philosophy, and challenges. The choices you make shape your future. Complete their tasks to uncover the storyline, dominate each unique game mode, and earn your place on the leaderboard.

🏁 GAME MODES

🏎 1. Racing (PvP and PvE)

Adrenaline-fueled competitions. Make your way through the sharp turns of racing tracks and overtake your rivals in destructible cars. PvE challenges teach you driving skills. And PvP allows you to test them in action and get real emotions.

"This is not just a race. This is your life on the line."

🎣 2. Fishing (PvE with PvP tournaments)

Think it's boring? Think again ;) Hidden lagoons, rogue waves, and rare legendary fish make this one of the most competitive arenas on the island. Sell your catch or participate in PvP fishing tournaments where time and instinct win.

"Yes, you can fish for money. And yes, others will try to take your place."

⚽️ 3. Car Soccer (PvP)

No rules. No judge. Real football with cars, real ball physics, and mind-blowing teamwork. Each match brings you reputation, coins, and sometimes... enemies.

"Play for glory or play for bets. Either way, don't play fair."

💥 4. Derby (PvP and PvE)

Metal meets madness. Fight your way through explosive arenas where survival is the only goal. Earn rewards in PvE or become a true savage in PvP modes, fighting to the last survivor.

"Your car will break down. The weak will not stand. The crowd is out for blood."

👊 5. Underground Fights (PvP and PvE)

Diverse fighting styles. Combos, skills, and juicy rewards.

PvE: Rise through the ranks, step into the octagon, and fight dozens of insidious opponents. Each fighter has their own style. Outsmart them, break their rhythm, and rise in the underground ranks.

PvP: One on one. No guns. No gear. Just fists, timing, and endurance.

"The deeper you go, the higher the stakes and the bigger the payouts."

⚔️ PvP vs PvE: Choose Your Path

Whether you're aiming for glory on the PvP leaderboards or just enjoying the game by completing PvE quests, RaceOnLife rewards both. Skill matters. Teamwork matters. But sometimes? Luck is everything.

"Pure skill and freedom of action."

💬 Message from us

We strive to make the game even better with your feedback. We really appreciate your constructive criticism and support as a new and ambitious team. Your input helps us grow and improve everyone's gaming experience. Don't hesitate to contact us, we would love to hear feedback from everyone!

"Let's make history together!"

content_descriptors.notes:
While our game is all about fun, freedom, and connecting with others, we also give players the ability to fully express themselves - sometimes with their fists. Fights can happen both in dedicated combat modes and across the open-world map, with visible blood and realistic action.

We do not encourage violence and strongly promote respectful, friendly gameplay. Still, the freedom we offer may lead to unpredictable - and sometimes intense - situations. Enjoy the chaos responsibly, and remember: the real win is making new allies, not enemies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 470 or NVIDIA GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5500XT or NVIDIA GTX 1660
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: 🌴"RaceOnLife" is a new genre multiplayer "Open World Racing and Fighting" game with ultra-realistic graphics, created on the Unreal Engine 5. Immerse yourself in a variety of game modes, including destructible motorcycles and cars, unique racing events and a completely new level of realism.
